title: CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler in $44 billion deal as AI supercharges cyberattacks
summary: CrowdStrike and competitors have shelled out billions to ramp up defenses in the wake of AI cyberattacks.
title_en: CrowdStrike to Buy Zscaler in $44 Billion Deal as AI Supercharges Cyberattacks
title_zh: CrowdStrike以440亿美元收购Zscaler，AI加剧网络攻击
summary_en: CrowdStrike agreed to acquire Zscaler for $44 billion, the latest major cybersecurity consolidation as AI-powered attacks push vendors to spend billions on stronger defenses.
summary_zh: CrowdStrike同意以440亿美元收购Zscaler，这是网络安全领域最新的大型整合，因AI驱动的攻击促使厂商投入数十亿美元加强防御。

title: Jensen Huang scheduled to testify next week in Senate following reinstatement as Nvidia CEO
summary: The public hearing follows bipartisan calls for Huang to testify about the affair with the suspected Chinese spy.
title_en: Jensen Huang to Testify Before Senate Next Week After Reinstatement as Nvidia CEO
title_zh: 黄仁勋复任英伟达CEO后将于下周出席参议院听证会
summary_en: Nvidia's reinstated CEO Jensen Huang will testify publicly before the Senate next week, following bipartisan demands for answers about his affair with a suspected Chinese spy.
summary_zh: 英伟达复任CEO黄仁勋将于下周出席参议院公开听证会，两党此前要求其就与疑似中国间谍的绯闻作出解释。

title: Elon Musk and others rejoice as Jensen Huang is reinstated at Nvidia amid scandal
summary: "The mistake has been corrected," Elon Musk chimed in.
title_en: Elon Musk and Others Rejoice as Jensen Huang Is Reinstated at Nvidia Amid Scandal
title_zh: 黄仁勋在丑闻中重返英伟达，马斯克等人欢呼
summary_en: Jensen Huang has been reinstated at Nvidia following a scandal, drawing praise from Elon Musk, who said "the mistake has been corrected." Details of the scandal remain unclear.
summary_zh: 黄仁勋在丑闻后重返英伟达，马斯克等人表示欢迎，称“错误已被纠正”。丑闻细节尚不清楚。

title: Megaspeed, the company at the center of the Jensen Huang scandal, appears headed for a US blacklist
summary: Megaspeed, which was previously led by Alice Huang, would be barred from doing business with U.S. companies unless those companies attained a special license from the federal government.
title_en: Megaspeed, at Center of Jensen Huang Scandal, Faces US Blacklist
title_zh: 卷入黄仁勋丑闻的Megaspeed或将被美国列入黑名单
summary_en: Megaspeed, formerly led by Alice Huang and linked to a Jensen Huang scandal, may be added to a US blacklist, barring it from doing business with American companies unless they obtain special federal licenses.
summary_zh: 曾由Alice Huang领导、与黄仁勋丑闻相关的Megaspeed可能被列入美国黑名单，除非获得联邦特别许可，否则将被禁止与美国公司开展业务。

title: AI data centers throw another wrench into chaotic UN climate talks
summary: The clean energy revolution hinges on electrifying the entire global economy just as power-hungry data centers are surging. It's a challenge delegates from all over the world had to grapple with during the United Nations climate conference, called COP31, that came to a chaotic and unsatisfying close in Antalya, Turkey, on Sunday. Each year, attendees […]
title_en: AI Data Centers Complicate Chaotic UN Climate Talks at COP31
title_zh: AI数据中心加剧COP31气候谈判混乱
summary_en: COP31 in Antalya closed chaotically as delegates grappled with surging power demand from AI data centers, complicating the clean energy transition amid an already fraught global climate negotiation.
summary_zh: 在土耳其安塔利亚举行的COP31气候大会混乱落幕，代表们需应对AI数据中心激增的电力需求，这为清洁能源转型增添了新的挑战。

title: Claude AI can review pull requests and ship fixes on its own now
summary: Anthropic is launching some new Claude AI features to help software engineers ship code. As part of a new Claude Ship product being announced today, Claude now can review, fix, and approve pull requests. Engineers have already been able to take advantage of Claude's code review capabilities thanks to the Code Review feature, which was […]
title_en: Claude AI Can Now Review Pull Requests and Ship Fixes Autonomously
title_zh: Claude AI现可自主审查拉取请求并提交修复
summary_en: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting Claude review, fix, and approve pull requests autonomously, expanding its code review capabilities into end-to-end code shipping for software engineers.
summary_zh: Anthropic推出Claude Ship产品，Claude现可自主审查、修复并批准拉取请求，将其代码审查能力扩展为面向软件工程师的端到端代码交付。

title: How Jensen Huang ended up as Nvidia CEO again
summary: The Jensen Huang era of Nvidia nearly came to an end this month. Huang, who three decades ago cofounded what's come to be considered one of the most important companies in AI, resigned from his role on November 12th over mounting scrutiny around his alleged affairs. Huang admitted he had been "unfaithful" to his wife […]
title_en: How Jensen Huang Ended Up as Nvidia CEO Again
title_zh: 黄仁勋如何再度出任英伟达CEO
summary_en: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO on November 12th amid scrutiny over alleged affairs, admitting he had been "unfaithful" to his wife. The report traces how he ultimately returned to lead the AI chip giant.
summary_zh: 黄仁勋于11月12日因涉嫌婚外情接受审查而辞去英伟达CEO一职，并承认对妻子“不忠”。报道梳理了他最终如何重返这家AI芯片巨头掌舵的过程。

title: Amazon to acquire AI startup Decart's chip software, hire founders
summary: Decart, founded in 2023, is best known for its software that lets developers sync their AI models across different chips.
title_en: Amazon to Acquire Decart's Chip Software, Hire Founders
title_zh: 亚马逊将收购Decart芯片软件并聘用其创始人
summary_en: Amazon is acquiring the chip software of AI startup Decart and hiring its founders, CNBC reported. Founded in 2023, Decart is known for software that syncs AI models across different chips, strengthening Amazon's AI infrastructure push.
summary_zh: 据CNBC报道，亚马逊将收购AI初创公司Decart的芯片软件并聘用其创始人。Decart成立于2023年，以支持AI模型跨不同芯片同步的软件著称，此举将增强亚马逊的AI基础设施布局。

title: Z AI Releases GLM-5.4: A 750B Loop Transformer That Runs 28 Layers Twice
summary: Z.ai released GLM-5.4, its first Loop Transformer flagship. The 750B-scale model runs 28 GLM-5 layers twice for deeper reasoning, with API access and open weights planned after safety work. The post Z AI Releases GLM-5.4: A 750B Loop Transformer That Runs 28 Layers Twice appeared first on MarkTechPost .
title_en: Z AI Releases GLM-5.4: A 750B Loop Transformer That Runs 28 Layers Twice
title_zh: Z AI发布GLM-5.4：750B循环Transformer，28层运行两遍
summary_en: Z.ai released GLM-5.4, its first Loop Transformer flagship. The 750B-scale model runs 28 GLM-5 layers twice for deeper reasoning, with API access and open weights planned after safety work.
summary_zh: Z.ai发布首款循环Transformer旗舰模型GLM-5.4，规模达750B，将28层GLM-5运行两遍以增强推理深度，API访问与开放权重将在安全评估后推出。

title: Oregon and Virginia sue SpaceX over Grok’s porn deepfakes
summary: In separate but similar lawsuits filed on Monday, Oregon Attorney General Dan Rayfield and Virginia Attorney General Jay Jones accused SpaceX of violating state consumer protection laws by ignoring industry-standard safeguards and falsely promoting the safety of its X social media platform and Grok AI features. The complaint filed in Virginia accuses Musk of willfully […]
title_en: Oregon and Virginia sue SpaceX over Grok's porn deepfakes
title_zh: 俄勒冈州和弗吉尼亚州就Grok色情深伪起诉SpaceX
summary_en: Oregon and Virginia attorneys general filed separate lawsuits accusing SpaceX of violating consumer protection laws by ignoring safeguards and falsely promoting the safety of X and Grok AI features.
summary_zh: 俄勒冈州和弗吉尼亚州总检察长分别提起诉讼，指控SpaceX违反消费者保护法，无视安全防护措施并虚假宣传X平台和Grok AI功能的安全性。

title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
summary: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux. It helps teams protect running systems while they roll out patches.
title_en: OpenAI and Cisco Introduce Shirudo, an Open-Source Linux Runtime
title_zh: OpenAI与思科推出开源Linux运行时Shirudo
summary_en: OpenAI and Cisco released Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux that helps teams protect running systems while they roll out patches, aiming to reduce exposure during patch deployment.
summary_zh: OpenAI与思科发布开源Linux运行时Shirudo，可在团队部署补丁期间保护运行中的系统，降低补丁部署过程中的暴露风险。

Nothing CEO Carl Pei demonstrated the new device […]
